W: Mr. Lee, I'm sorry. I left my science report at home again.
M: That's the second time this month, Annie. All your classmates handed theirs in yesterday.
W: I'll bring it to your office tomorrow morning.
M: OK. And don't forget that the final exam is next week.
N: Question: What is the relationship between the two speakers?

stem: How does the girl probably feel?
options: She is excited about the result.
She is proud of her dance.
She is bored with dancing now.
She is upset about how she did.
explanation: Wendy 練了三個月，比賽時卻忘了舞步、站在那裡不動；男孩安慰她「Don't be so hard on yourself」，她說「I can't stop thinking about it」，一直想著這件事，可以推論她對自己的表現很難過、很在意。
hints: Wendy 比賽時發生了什麼事？
男孩為什麼要安慰她？她最後說一直在想這件事，表示心情如何？

wrong.B: 她在比賽中忘了舞步，男孩還要安慰她，不會是覺得驕傲。
wrong.A: 她一直想著自己的失誤，對結果並不興奮。
wrong.C: 她練了三個月，是在意這次表現，不是對跳舞感到無聊。

listen:
M: How was the dance contest yesterday, Wendy?
W: I practiced every day for three months, but in the middle of the dance, I forgot the steps. I just stood there.
M: Don't be so hard on yourself. Everyone makes mistakes.
W: I know, but I can't stop thinking about it.
N: Question: How does the girl probably feel?

stem: Which phone case will the woman probably buy?
explanation: 紅色最便宜但太大，不合手機；黑色剛好但要六百元，她只帶了五百元，買不起；白色合手機、四百五十元，錢也夠。男孩提醒她不喜歡白色，她說可以貼貼紙，表示這個缺點她能解決，所以她最可能買白色的。
hints: 三種手機殼各有什麼優點和缺點？
她帶了多少錢？哪一個買得起又合手機？
男孩提出的問題，她最後怎麼回應？

wrong.A: 紅色雖然最便宜，但 it's too big for your phone，太大不合用。
wrong.B: 黑色合手機，但要六百元，她只帶了五百元。
wrong.C: 對話中沒有提到藍色的手機殼。

listen:
W: Which phone case should I buy?
M: The red one is the cheapest, but it's too big for your phone. The black one fits well, but it's six hundred dollars.
W: I only brought five hundred. What about the white one? It fits, and it's four hundred fifty.
M: But you said you didn't like white things.
W: Well, I can put some stickers on it.
N: Question: Which phone case will the woman probably buy?

stem: Who is this announcement for?
explanation: 廣播說「The next station is City Hall. The doors on the left will open.」，還請要去動物園的人在這站換搭棕線（change to the Brown Line），並請大家握好扶手、讓座。下一站、左側開門、換線，可以推論是給搭捷運的乘客聽的。
hints: 廣播一開始說「下一個」什麼？
換到另一條「線」、握好扶手、讓座，這是在什麼交通工具上？

wrong.C: 機場的廣播會說班機和登機門，不會說下一站和換線。
wrong.B: 看電影時不會有下一站、開門和讓座的廣播。
wrong.D: 購物中心的廣播會說特價或樓層，不會說換搭某條線。

listen:
N: The next station is City Hall. The doors on the left will open. Passengers going to the zoo, please change to the Brown Line at this station. Please hold the handrail and give your seat to people who need it.
N: Question: Who is this announcement for?

stem: What will listeners hear at nine tonight?
options: Story Time and then a report.
A report about a ball game.
explanation: 廣播說今晚九點的節目 Story Time 不播（will not be on at nine），「Instead, we will bring you a special report on the high school basketball final.」，改播高中籃球決賽的特別報導，所以九點會聽到球賽的報導。
hints: Story Time 平常幾點播？今晚會照常播嗎？
Instead 後面說改播什麼？

wrong.B: 廣播說 Story Time will not be on at nine，今晚九點不播。
wrong.C: 廣播中沒有提到天氣預報。
wrong.A: Story Time 今晚不會播，要明天晚上才回來，不是先播故事再播報導。

listen:
N: Thank you for listening to Happy Radio. Tonight, our program Story Time will not be on at nine as usual. Instead, we will bring you a special report on the high school basketball final. Story Time will be back tomorrow night at the same time.
N: Question: What will listeners hear at nine tonight?

stem: What will happen if a visitor returns a bike at 6:30 p.m.?
options: The visitor will pay 100 dollars more.
The visitor will get a free helmet.
The visitor can't rent bikes again.
The visitor will pay 200 dollars more.
explanation: 廣播說腳踏車要在下午五點半前歸還，晚還「you will need to pay one hundred dollars for each extra hour」，每多一小時付一百元。六點半還車比五點半晚了一小時，所以要多付 100 × 1 = 100 元。
hints: 腳踏車要在幾點以前還？
六點半比規定的時間晚了幾小時？每晚一小時要付多少錢？

wrong.D: 把晚還的時間算成兩小時，五點半到六點半只差一小時。
wrong.C: 廣播只說晚還要付錢，沒有說以後不能再租。
wrong.B: 安全帽是全程都要戴的規定（wear a helmet at all times），不是送給遊客的禮物。

listen:
N: Welcome to the Lakeside Bike Path. You can rent bikes at the visitor center. Please wear a helmet at all times. All bikes must be returned by five thirty p.m. If you return your bike late, you will need to pay one hundred dollars for each extra hour.
N: Question: What will happen if a visitor returns a bike at 6:30 p.m.?

stem: What will Mr. Brown get because of the problem?
options: One more night at no cost.
Free use of the pool on Monday.
explanation: 飯店說游泳池這個週末要維修、不能用，「To say sorry, we will give you breakfast for free on both mornings.」，為了表示歉意，他住的兩個早上都提供免費早餐，也就是兩頓不用錢的早餐。
hints: 飯店發生了什麼問題？
To say sorry 後面，飯店說要給 Brown 先生什麼？
both mornings 是幾個早上？

wrong.A: 飯店沒有說要免費多住一晚，他訂的還是兩晚。
wrong.D: 游泳池是維修中的設施，飯店沒有說星期一可以免費使用。
wrong.B: 留言中沒有提到給他比較便宜的房間。

listen:
W: Hello, Mr. Brown. This is Sunshine Hotel. You have a room with us for two nights, starting this Friday. I'm sorry to tell you that our swimming pool will be closed this weekend for repairs. To say sorry, we will give you breakfast for free on both mornings. If you have any questions, please call us at 2233-4455.
N: Question: What will Mr. Brown get because of the problem?

stem: Which of the following is true according to Sam's message?
options: The group will meet in the afternoon.
Sam's laptop will be used for the work.
Ivy still has to finish the poster.
They will meet at nine on Sunday morning.
explanation: Sam 說因為 Lisa 星期六不能來，改成星期天；圖書館九點開，但早上的讀書室都被訂走了，「so let's meet at one」，一點是下午，所以小組會在下午見面。另外 Sam 的筆電壞了、要 Ivy 帶，海報 Sam 已經做好了。
hints: 見面的日子為什麼從星期六改成星期天？
九點是什麼的時間？他們最後約幾點？那是上午還是下午？
再確認：誰的筆電壞了？海報做完了沒？

wrong.C: Sam 說 I've already finished it，海報他已經做好了，Ivy 不用再做。
wrong.B: Sam 說 mine is broken，他的筆電壞了，所以請 Ivy 帶她的。
wrong.D: 九點是圖書館開門的時間，但早上的讀書室都被訂走了，他們約的是一點。

listen:
M: Hi, Ivy. It's Sam. I'm calling about our group project. Lisa can't come on Saturday, so we'll meet on Sunday instead. The library opens at nine on Sundays, but all the study rooms are booked in the morning, so let's meet at one. Please bring your laptop, because mine is broken. And don't worry about the poster. I've already finished it.
N: Question: Which of the following is true according to Sam's message?

stem: Why does Grace cook dinner on Sundays?
options: She wants to be a cook someday.
Her parents can't cook very well.
Her little brother asks her to.
She wants to do something nice for her parents.
explanation: Grace 說爸媽星期一到星期六都工作得很辛苦，所以她每個星期天煮晚餐，「I want them to relax and enjoy a nice meal on their day off.」，她想讓爸媽在休假日好好休息、吃頓好飯，也就是為爸媽做一件貼心的事。
hints: Grace 的爸媽平常怎麼樣？
注意 I want them to... 這一句，她希望爸媽星期天怎麼樣？

wrong.B: 短文說的是爸媽工作很辛苦，沒有說他們不會煮飯。
wrong.A: 短文中沒有提到她以後想當廚師。
wrong.C: 弟弟只是吃了還想再來一碗，並不是弟弟要她煮的。

listen:
N: Hi, I'm Grace. I love cooking. My parents work very hard from Monday to Saturday, so every Sunday I cook dinner for my family. I want them to relax and enjoy a nice meal on their day off. Last Sunday, I made fried rice and tomato soup. My little brother asked for a second bowl!
N: Question: Why does Grace cook dinner on Sundays?

stem: What do Plant Club members do during summer vacation?
options: They sell vegetables at the fair.
They meet twice a week after school.
They go back to school to give the plants water.
explanation: 短文說暑假沒有上課，但植物還是需要水，「So members take turns coming to school to water them.」，社員輪流回學校幫植物澆水。每週二、四放學後照顧花園是上課期間的事，春天種菜、秋天賣菜也都不是暑假。
hints: 短文依照季節說了社團在不同時候做的事，暑假是哪一段？
暑假沒有上課，植物需要什麼？社員怎麼安排？

wrong.B: 每週二、四放學後是上課期間的活動，暑假沒有上課。
wrong.A: 賣菜是秋天（In the fall）在學校園遊會的事。
wrong.D: 種番茄和紅蘿蔔是春天（In spring）的事。

listen:
N: Our school has a Plant Club. Every Tuesday and Thursday after school, club members take care of the school garden. In spring, we grow vegetables like tomatoes and carrots. In summer vacation, there are no classes, but the plants still need water. So members take turns coming to school to water them. In the fall, we sell our vegetables at the school fair and use the money to buy new tools.
N: Question: What do Plant Club members do during summer vacation?

stem: What does the speaker suggest students do?
options: Review everything the night before a test.
Rest well and review early for tests.
Sleep less so they have time to review.
Study late at night before a big test.
explanation: 短文先說很多學生以為熬夜讀書最好，再用 However 轉折：睡眠對學習很重要，睡覺時大腦會整理白天學的東西；睡不到七小時的學生上課容易累、容易忘。最後建議「review your lessons a few days early, and go to bed on time the night before」，也就是早點複習、考前好好睡覺。
hints: 短文一開始提到很多學生相信什麼？However 後面的說法一樣嗎？
最後一句 So next time... 是作者的建議，他要學生做哪兩件事？

wrong.D: 熬夜讀書是很多學生「以為」的方法，作者用 However 表示不同意。
wrong.C: 作者說睡不到七小時的學生容易累、容易忘，不會建議少睡。
wrong.A: 作者建議提早幾天複習（a few days early），考前一晚要準時睡覺，不是考前一晚才全部複習。

listen:
N: Many students believe that studying late at night is the best way to get good grades. However, scientists have found that sleep plays an important part in learning. While we are sleeping, our brains organize what we learned during the day and help us remember it. Students who sleep less than seven hours often feel tired in class and forget things easily. So next time you have a big test, review your lessons a few days early, and go to bed on time the night before.
N: Question: What does the speaker suggest students do?
